title: Intervention-Aware Clinical World Model for Post-Op Outcome Forecasting in Cardiology
abstract: arXiv:2608.13518v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many clinical prediction models treat post-intervention outcomes as a one-step mapping from baseline measurements to a future endpoint. However, recovery after a procedure often unfolds as an irregular trajectory: clinical observations, medication changes, repeat interventions, and physiological measurements are recorded asynchronously and can change risk assessment over time. We propose an intervention-aware clinical world model that represents each patient with a structured latent state and evolves it through time-ordered post-intervention events. The model first encodes baseline imaging into a 3D spatial latent state. It then updates this state using procedural context, static covariates, elapsed time, and peri-event physiological embeddings. translated_title: 干预感知的临床世界模型用于心脏病学术后结果预测
translated_abstract: 许多临床预测模型将干预后结果视为从基线测量到未来终点的单步映射。然而，手术后的恢复通常表现为不规则的轨迹：临床观察、药物调整、重复干预和生理测量以异步方式记录，并可能随时间改变风险评估。我们提出了一种干预感知的临床世界模型，该模型用结构化潜在状态表示每位患者，并通过按时间顺序排列的术后事件来演化该状态。模型首先将基线影像编码为3D空间潜在状态，然后利用手术背景、静态协变量、经过时间和围事件生理嵌入来更新该状态。随访影像通过潜在预测目标提供仅训练时的监督。我们将该框架应用于心房颤动消融。在90天恢复窗口期间，不规则p
tldr: 提出一种干预感知的临床世界模型，通过结构化潜在状态和时序事件演化来预测术后恢复轨迹，并在心房颤动消融中验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: We propose an intervention-aware clinical world model that evolves structured latent states through time-ordered post-operative events to forecast irregular recovery trajectories, demonstrated in atrial fibrillation ablation.
